name: Center at Pomfret Bike Camp
operator_name: Connecticut Audubon Society Center at Pomfret
description_short: Small group bike camp for ages 9 to 13 run by the Connecticut Audubon Society Center at Pomfret. Campers ride local back roads and trails such as the Airline Trail while learning about birds, wildlife, habitats and local history.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Ages 9 to 13, $242 for CAS members and $300 for non-members, 10 campers per session, 9 am to 4 pm. Address and phone are the Center at Pomfret's (218 Day Road, Pomfret Center 06259). Drop off and pick up places vary through the week.
Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 brochure: three weeks; early drop off and late pick up for an added fee; campers bring their own fitted bike, helmet and spare tube.

source.title: Summer Camp at Pomfret | The Connecticut Audubon Society

unknowns: Registration link (registration is by email or phone)

for_andrew: Pomfret (village of Pomfret Center) is not in cities.py and no town it belongs to is either, so the draft fails the city check. Needs a cities.py entry for Pomfret, CT, or drop the listing.
Drop off and pick up places change during the week, so 218 Day Road is the center's address, not necessarily where riders meet each day.
